experiments.primary_claim: Distinguish control defects and nondeterminism from state-dependent contact failures.
Find physically useful, executable contact-phase corrections under full-task constraints.
Get well-trained same-authority residual RL, with full-cost baselines.
Isolate additional causal value of explicit action-effect feedback over equal-observation/history RL and strong planning.
After a reliable independent gain, test novel conditions, another contact mechanism and industrial adapter.

unresolved_questions: Can we reproduce STAP's original CEM+skill Q/dynamics planning mechanism at high fidelity, then port to the exact same two-skill physical contract without future oracle state?
Do new stable-grasp+tool-load and varied successor-goal conditions exhibit reproducible task-dependent parameter ranking beyond the strongest whole-suffix rule and STAP model search?
Can any SkillResult/successor-contract auxiliary learning mechanism improve real full-task success or predeclared physics-data/query efficiency beyond equal-data STAP, Foresight and ordinary RL?
Can an actually trained two-dimensional SAC effective-action policy remove the unused-Z entropy/critic confound without covert extra information?
After a concrete gain, does it survive independent training seeds, new scene groups, a second distinct task and correctly counted physical costs?
